The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is **HD 100546 b**.  
It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius of roughly **2.5 × the radius of Jupiter** (about 1.8 × 10⁵ km). This makes it the biggest exoplanet we know of, though future discoveries may reveal even larger worlds.
